text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ad-Dustour learns that the Central Bank has allowed commercial banks to lend in foreign currencies without restrictions.
- Jordan opens first trade fair for industrial goods in West Bank town of Ramallah. Bilateral meetings today to discuss improving economic relations.
- Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller to visit Jordan next week. Turkish ambassador says Jordan and Turkey plan regional cooperation and security organisation.
- Information Minister Muasher says Jordan welcomes second term for U.S. President Clinton.
- Parliamentary speaker Srour to keep his post after rival candidate says he's stepping down.
- King Hussein and Israeli President Ezer Weizman call for implementing agreements and deepening understanding.
- Saudi Prince Talal bin Abdul Aziz expected in Jordan on Saturday at the invitation of King Hussein.
